info.text:
Nearly 2 in 3 new Vanguard 401(k) dollars bought one fund type in 2025.
That fund type is the target-date fund (Vanguard How America Saves 2026), and 98% of default funds (QDIAs) in Vanguard 401(k)s were target-date funds.
The glide path shifts stocks to bonds. Vanguard's goes from about 90% stocks at 25 to 50% at 65 and 30% by 72 (assuming retirement at 65).
The average target-date mutual fund fee was 0.27% in 2025, per Morningstar, or $27 a year on a $10,000 example balance.
Sources: Vanguard How America Saves 2026, Morningstar 2026 Target-Date Landscape, FINRA.
News and education, not financial advice.
